procedure_column: Zega+2025 | Cameca SX-100 Ultra | WDS Point Analysis (K-ALFAA U.Arizona)

Procedure Name.cell: EPMA Major Element Silicates/Sulfides/Oxides/Phosphates/Carbonates, Bennu (K-ALFAA, Cameca SX-100 Ultra)
Procedure Name.value: EPMA Major Element Silicates/Sulfides/Oxides/Phosphates/Carbonates, Bennu (K-ALFAA, Cameca SX-100 Ultra)

Laboratory.cell: Kuiper-Arizona Laboratory for Astromaterials Analysis (K-ALFAA), University of Arizona
Laboratory.value: Kuiper-Arizona Laboratory for Astromaterials Analysis (K-ALFAA), University of Arizona

Target Material.cell: silicates; sulfides; oxides; phosphates; carbonates — p.9

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain > Phase — sulfide compositions are reported per grain within named particles ("Pyrrhotite compositions measured by EMPA", p.2), and "phase mapping via electron microprobe analysis (EMPA)" gives modal abundances of carbonates, sulfides and magnetite per particle (p.2)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: N — beam conditions are given per phase ("Quantitative analyses of silicates, sulfides and oxides were run using a focused beam"; "A 2-μm defocused beam size, lower beam currents and shorter count times were used for phosphate and carbonate analyses", p.9), but that is a setting per phase, not a rule for choosing which grains were analysed

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: SEM imaging and EDS mapping before the probe — particles were characterized by SE and BSE imaging and by EDS mapping of "The compositional heterogeneity of the particles" (p.9), and the paper's Fig. 1 pairs those BSE images with the EMPA data (p.2); the Methods list SEM before electron microprobe analysis without stating an explicit order
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: SEM imaging and EDS mapping before the probe

Instrument Model.cell: SX-100 Ultra (stated as "SX-100 Ultra electron microprobe in the K-ALFAA")
Instrument Model.value: SX-100 Ultra (stated as "SX-100 Ultra electron microprobe in the K-ALFAA")

Beam Mode.cell: silicates, sulfides, oxides: Focused; phosphates, carbonates: Defocused — 'Quantitative analyses of silicates, sulfides and oxides were run using a focused beam ... A 2-μm defocused beam size ... for phosphate and carbonate analyses'

Beam Current.cell: silicates, sulfides, oxides: 20 nA; phosphates: 8 nA; carbonates: 4 nA — p.9

Beam Diameter.cell: phosphates, carbonates: 2 µm; other: N — p.9

Beam Damage Minimization.cell: phosphates, carbonates: 2 µm defocused beam, lower beam currents and shorter count times; other: N — 'to minimize possible beam damage effects'

value.value: 2 µm defocused beam, lower beam currents and shorter count times

Mapping Beam Current.cell: 20 nA — 'X-ray maps and BSE images were run at 15kV and 20nA'

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: N — "Well-characterized natural and synthetic materials were used as standards" (p.9); the paper gives beam conditions and count times for silicates, sulfides, oxides, phosphates and carbonates but names no element

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Fe + Co, S, Ni; modal abundance of carbonates, sulfides and magnetite — sulfide compositions in at% (Fig. 1); modal abundances '0.4–3.4%, ~3–8% and ~3–5%' from the EMPA phase maps (p.2)

Peak Counting Time.cell: N — stated per material, not per element, and no element is named: '20 s peak time' (silicates, sulfides, oxides), '20 s peak' (phosphates), '10 s peak' (carbonates)

Background Counting Time.cell: N — stated per material: '10 s on each background' (silicates, sulfides, oxides), '10 s background' (phosphates), '5 s background' (carbonates)

Background Position(s).cell: N — '10 s on each background' implies two positions, which are not given

X-ray Background Correction Method.cell: N — no background method is named

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — no contributing count and no acceptance or rejection rule is stated for the microprobe analyses; the modal abundances come from classified phase-map pixels rather than from admitting or excluding results (p.9)

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: N — 'Well-characterized natural and synthetic materials were used as standards'

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Zega et al. 2025, Nat. Geosci. — mineralogical evidence for hydrothermal alteration of Bennu. K-ALFAA, University of Arizona. Instrument stated as "SX-100 Ultra electron microprobe in the K-ALFAA". IMPORTANT: v2 had "no protocol details reported" — this was WRONG. The paper provides detailed EPMA conditions: X-ray maps and BSE images: 15 kV, 20 nA. Silicates/sulfides/oxides: 15 kV, 20 nA, focused, 20 s peak, 10 s/bg each side. Phosphates: 15 kV, 8 nA, 2 µm defocused, 20 s peak, 10 s/bg each side. Carbonates: 15 kV, 4 nA, 2 µm, 10 s peak, 5 s/bg each side. Standards: "well-characterized natural and synthetic materials" (specific names N). Phase maps generated using XMapTools. WDS and matrix correction NOT explicitly stated in paper.
